messages.content: Can you help me find public libraries in New York, NY that have a Reading Room and Fiction section, and then in Los Angeles, CA that offer Wi-Fi and have a Children Section, and finally in Chicago, IL that have a Cafe and a Reading Room?

function.name: public_library_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby public libraries based on specific criteria like English fiction availability and Wi-Fi. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Boston, MA

facilities.description: Facilities and sections in public library.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function multiple times with different parameters. The function signature: public_library_find_nearby takes location (string) and facilities (one of the union types). But the facilities parameter seems to accept only one value from the union: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe". However we need to search for libraries that have multiple facilities. The function might support specifying multiple facilities? The description says "Facilities and sections in public library." It lists options but not clear if it accepts array or single string. The type definition shows facilities: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[]; Wait the type shows "Cafe"[], meaning an array of strings? Actually the type is "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[]. That means facilities can be either one of those strings or an array of "Cafe"? That seems odd. Maybe it's a mistake. Possibly they intended facilities: ("Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe")[]; i.e., an array of those strings. So we should pass an array of desired facilities.

Thus we will call the function three times:

1. location: "New York, NY", facilities: ["Reading Room", "Fiction"]
2. location: "Los Angeles, CA", facilities: ["Wi-Fi", "Children Section"]
3. location: "Chicago, IL", facilities: ["Cafe", "Reading Room"]

We'll produce calls accordingly.
